evidence: log loss +0.0164 (95% interval +0.0074 to +0.0246). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

325 picks, ROI +1.4% (95% interval -6.9% to +9.1%), win rate 60.3% against a break-even 59.0%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 13% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.12 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,855 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,748; a 1% edge takes 43,691. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
